content.json: AUTOMATION ACCOUNT REPORT - Please first choose an account from the parameter box.

parameters.name: paramSubscription
parameters.description: Allows you to choose a subscription
parameters.label: Subscription

parameters.name: paramAutomationAccount
parameters.label: Automation Account
parameters.description: Allows you to choose from a list of Automation Accounts
parameters.query:
AzureDiagnostics 
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize by Resource
| order by Resource asc

parameters.name: paramTimeRange
parameters.label: Time Range
parameters.description: Allows you to choose a time range

content.query:
let expectedStatuses = datatable(ResultType:string)
[
    "Completed","Failed","Started","Created","Suspended","Stopped"
];
expectedStatuses
| join kind=leftouter (
    AzureDiagnostics
    | where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and SubscriptionId == '{paramSubscription:subscriptionid}'
    | where Category == "JobLogs"
    | where RunbookName_s != "ImportAutomationModuleACI"
    | where isnotempty(RunbookName_s)
    | where TimeGenerated {paramTimeRange}
    | extend AutomationAccount = tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])
    | where (isempty('{paramAutomationAccount}') or AutomationAccount == '{paramAutomationAccount}')
    | summarize Count=count() by ResultType
) on ResultType
| project ResultType, Count=coalesce(Count, 0)
content.title: RUNBOOK STATUSES

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and SubscriptionId == '{paramSubscription:subscriptionid}'
| where Category == "JobLogs"
| where RunbookName_s != "ImportAutomationModuleACI" 
| where isnotempty(RunbookName_s)
| where TimeGenerated {paramTimeRange}
| extend AutomationAccount = tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| where (isempty('{paramAutomationAccount}') or AutomationAccount == '{paramAutomationAccount}')
| where ResultDescription == "Job Completed"
| summarize count() by RunbookName=RunbookName_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics 
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and SubscriptionId == '{paramSubscription:subscriptionid}'
| where Category == "JobLogs" and (ResultType == "Failed" or ResultType == "Stopped" or ResultType == "Suspended") and TimeGenerated {paramTimeRange}
| extend AutomationAccount = tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| where (isempty('{paramAutomationAccount}') or AutomationAccount == '{paramAutomationAccount}')
| project TimeGenerated , RunbookName_s , ResultType , _ResourceId , JobId_g
content.title: RUNBOOKS WITH ISSUES 🤔

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics 
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and SubscriptionId == '{paramSubscription:subscriptionid}' 
| where TimeGenerated {paramTimeRange}
| where Category == "JobStreams" and StreamType_s == "Error"
| extend AutomationAccount = tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| where (isempty('{paramAutomationAccount}') or AutomationAccount == '{paramAutomationAccount}')
| project Runbook=RunbookName_s,JobId=JobId_g,TimeGenerated,ResultDescription

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and SubscriptionId == '{paramSubscription:subscriptionid}' and RunbookName_s != "ImportAutomationModuleACI"
| extend AutomationAccount = tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| where (isempty('{paramAutomationAccount}') or AutomationAccount == '{paramAutomationAccount}')
| where ResultType == "Started" or ResultType == "Completed"
| order by JobId_g, RunbookName_s, TimeGenerated asc
| extend Duration = iff(ResultType != "Started" and prev(ResultType) == "Started", TimeGenerated - prev(TimeGenerated), timespan(null)), prev(RunbookName_s)
| extend StartTime = prev(TimeGenerated)
| extend Duration = bin(Duration,1s)
| where isnotnull(Duration)
| project StartTime, Duration, Runbook=RunbookName_s, Resource
| order by StartTime
